title: Ok but is now leaking after 7 months
text: Ok but is now leaking after 7 months. We have been sleeping nightly on this exact same bed for 7months. It now has a slow leak we can NOT find. We have to blow up the mattress about 4 times a night to keep it firm. It causes pain in our bodies as you end up in a weird slump. I have to admit it maybe that our 3 year old grandson and 6 year old son like to jump on it could have caused the issue. But due to the fabric layer we can not find the leak to fix it. I will buy another one but not this one. We had to add a 3" foam topper for comfort as well as it was just not comfortable without it.
